inputs.name: CLIPROXY_PROFILE
inputs.description: Profile whose defaults apply.

inputs.name: HOME
inputs.description: Home directory the XDG base directory defaults derive from.

inputs.name: XDG_STATE_HOME
inputs.description: XDG state base directory.

inputs.name: XDG_RUNTIME_DIR
inputs.description: XDG runtime directory, which holds the development protected file.

inputs.name: CLIPROXY_OVERLAY_FILES
inputs.description: Colon-separated YAML files of configuration inputs; a later file overrides an earlier one.

inputs.name: CLIPROXY_PROTECTED_FILE
inputs.description: YAML file of protected inputs, readable by its owner alone.

inputs.name: server.host
inputs.description: Interface address the HTTP listener binds.

inputs.name: server.port
inputs.description: TCP port of the HTTP listener.

inputs.name: access.api-keys
inputs.description: Keys clients present to use the proxy API.

inputs.name: oauth.auth-dir
inputs.description: Directory of the credential files the proxy reads, refreshes, and writes.

inputs.name: requests.proxy-url
inputs.description: Proxy URL for upstream requests; empty sends them directly.

inputs.name: routing.strategy
inputs.description: How a request chooses among eligible credentials.

inputs.name: routing.retry.request-retry
inputs.description: Retries of a failed upstream request on another credential.

inputs.name: routing.retry.max-retry-interval
inputs.description: Longest credential cooldown, in seconds, a request waits out before retrying.

inputs.name: client.codex.enable-apply-patch
inputs.description: Advertise freeform apply_patch for every model all routing executors support.

inputs.name: client.codex.optimize-multi-agent-v2
inputs.description: Optimize Codex client requests for multi-agent v2.

inputs.name: OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER
inputs.description: Trace exporter: otlp, console, or none.

inputs.name: OTEL_METRICS_EXPORTER
inputs.description: Metric exporter: otlp, console, or none.

inputs.name: OTEL_LOGS_EXPORTER
inputs.description: Log exporter: otlp, console, or none.

inputs.name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT
inputs.description: OTLP/HTTP base URL; each signal appends its path.

inputs.name: CLIPROXY_DEPLOYMENT_ENVIRONMENT
inputs.description: Deployment environment the telemetry reports.

inputs.name: telemetry.otlp-headers
inputs.description: Headers of OTLP requests, as comma-separated key=value pairs with URL-encoded values.

inputs.name: local-model
inputs.description: Use the embedded model catalogs instead of the official remote sources.

inputs.name: codex-login
inputs.description: Log in to Codex with OAuth, write the credential file, and exit.

inputs.name: codex-device-login
inputs.description: Log in to Codex with the device code flow, write the credential file, and exit.

inputs.name: claude-login
inputs.description: Log in to Claude with OAuth, write the credential file, and exit.

inputs.name: antigravity-login
inputs.description: Log in to Antigravity with OAuth, write the credential file, and exit.

inputs.name: kimi-login
inputs.description: Log in to Kimi (.com) with OAuth, write the credential file, and exit.

inputs.name: kimi-ai-login
inputs.description: Log in to Kimi.ai with OAuth, write the credential file, and exit.

inputs.name: xai-login
inputs.description: Log in to xAI with OAuth, write the credential file, and exit.

inputs.name: devin-login
inputs.description: Log in to Devin with OAuth, write the credential file, and exit.

inputs.name: meta-login
inputs.description: Log in to Meta with OAuth, write the credential file, and exit.

inputs.name: no-browser
inputs.description: Print the login URL instead of opening a browser.

inputs.name: oauth-callback-port
inputs.description: Port of the login callback listener; 0 uses the provider's port.

inputs.name: vertex-import
inputs.description: Import this Vertex service account key file as a credential and exit.

inputs.name: vertex-import-prefix
inputs.description: Model namespace prefix of the imported Vertex credential.

inputs.name: siwc-bind
inputs.description: Bind Sign in with ChatGPT credentials to this Codex credential file and exit.

inputs.name: telemetry-probe
inputs.description: Emit the qualification trace, metric, and log record, print their correlation identifier, and exit.
